title: Content page
description: Official page chrome: site header, page header with title, site footer.

components.reason: EC/EU identity banner, language selector, site name
Carries the page h1, meta, and description
Usually inside the page header for deep pages
Commission contact and legal links; last element

validationOrder: Single h1 lives in the page header
Breadcrumb last segment has aria-current='page' without a link
EU emblem usage follows Commission identity rules
a11yNotes: Logo alt text present and meaningful
Language selector is essential for 24-language ECL sites
agentPromptSequence: 1. Place the site header with logo and language selector
2. Add the page header carrying the h1
3. Breadcrumb inside the page header for deep pages
4. Wrap content in <main>, close with the site footer
